snippet.title: KNELL — Official Trailer | A Grim Folk-Horror Survivors-Like
snippet.description:
The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. KNELL is a grim folk-horror
survivors-like — hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins.

▶ Free demo (Windows / Linux / macOS): https://playknell.com/demo

You are the last keeper of a plague-dead parish. Each night you ring the
passing bell for the dead, as the office demands — but the bell has begun
calling something back. Twenty minutes of dark, and everything in it wants
your candle out.

THE NIGHT
• The bell keeps time. Every minute it tolls, and every toll calls worse
  dead. At the tenth and the last, the Tolling Ones.
• Eight rites turned violent — the censer, the salt ring, coffin nails,
  holy water, the knell itself. Pair a rite with its matching relic and it
  evolves into something the parish never sanctioned.
• The night changes, not just hardens. Past the fifteenth toll the
  churchyard floods — walls and rings of hundreds.
• Fall, and the night still pays. Ash buys permanent restoration in the
  Reliquary: new keepers, new strength, a longer fuse.

LINKS
Demo — https://playknell.com/demo
Site — https://playknell.com
Discord — https://discord.gg/knell

KNELL is made by Mainframe Gaming, and runs on a bespoke engine written
from scratch in C++ — no commercial game engine. Every sound in this
trailer is the game's own audio.

#survivorslike #indiegame #folkhorror
